authorization_pattern: option 1 from the CLI-finalization task: the expected authorized Person D HEAD is read from a committed JSON object at runtime, never embedded self-referentially in the commit that would need to cite its own hash.
authorization_record_path_cli_override: --authorization-record-path (defaults to the path above; exposed explicitly so a real deployment can point at a different, later-refreshed record without editing this script)

checked_fields.authorized_runner_commit: must equal git rev-parse HEAD exactly
checked_fields.branch: must equal role/person-d-baselines exactly (never detached HEAD, never another branch)
checked_fields.exporter_commit_is_ancestor: fd9302e5d218193211f2f96986ca32dc1a365e66 must be an ancestor of HEAD

how_person_b_issues_final_execution_auth: Person B (or whoever holds execution authority) confirms the exact Person D commit to deploy, verifies docs/status/person_d_phase4_step4_1_eight_family_production_v0_2/authorized_runner_commit.json already cites that exact commit (refreshing it via a new commit if the branch has advanced since), and only then invokes the CLI's run mode on that exact checked-out commit in the approved SageMaker environment. verify_branch_and_authorization (scripts/run_person_d_step4_1_eight_family_production.py) enforces all four checked fields simultaneously and fails closed (nonzero exit, no baseline fit) if any one of them does not hold -- this applies identically to materialize and run mode.
rejection_behavior: authorization for a different Person D commit -> head_not_authorized:head=...:authorized=...
detached HEAD or another branch -> wrong_branch:'<branch>'
exporter commit not an ancestor of HEAD -> exporter_commit_not_ancestor
